description.summary: The checkout deployment is leaking memory and will be OOMKilled within the hour.
description.details: Container RSS has grown monotonically for 4h without reclaim after garbage collection. Working set is at 92% of the configured limit and the growth rate implies an OOMKill in roughly 40 minutes. Downstream, the payments service is already seeing elevated p99 latency because checkout is holding connections open longer as it approaches the limit.

remediationOptions.title: Restart the affected pods
remediationOptions.description: Immediate mitigation that reclaims the leaked memory but does not address the underlying defect.

remediationOptions.title: Roll back to the previous revision
remediationOptions.description: Revision 4f2b1a9 introduced an unbounded in-memory cache; the prior revision does not exhibit the growth pattern.
